records.title: Effective Implementation of the National Education Policy, 2020
details:
For realizing the vision of "Make AI in India and Make Al work for India", the Government had
approved establishment of three Centres of Excellence (CoE) in Artificial Intelligence (AI) with a total financial outlay of Rs. 990.00 Cr

records.title: IMPLEMENTATION OF SMART RATION CARD AND END-TO-END DIGITIZATION
details: CONSUMER AFFAIRS, FOOD AND PUBLIC DISTRIBUTION

Department is in the process of converting 150 owned Depots of Food Corporation of India (FCI) to smart warehouses on pilot basis. Besides, all the food grain depots of Central Warehousing Corporation (CWC) are also covered under smart warehouse Project.
FCI operational steel-silo capacity has increased to 29.5 LMT, with projects underway to raise it to nearly 90 LMT in coming 2-3 years, marking a major shift from traditional godown-based storage to modern scientific systems.

records.title: Installation of new supercomputers in the country
details: New supercomputers of 21.1 PetaFlops capacity will be installed this year by the Ministry.
